rationale: resolve_asset_file now refuses a document-loaded asset path that leaves the document directory by text, before any filesystem lookup (.. folded, backslashes as separators, absolute, drive-letter and UNC roots), keeping the resolved-path symlink check as a second layer and the declared-sha256 exception; the refusal no longer reveals whether an outside file exists. Generic DesignIR asset-resolution hardening landed in Pulp per the 2026-10-04 temporary ownership exception; Vellum inherits it. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
